newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * Romania's parliament commisions ended debates on the 1997 draft budget, the state radio said. The draft will be submitted and debated in parliament starting next week.
* The Commissioner of the Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe on ethnic minorities, Max Van der Stoel, met the chairmen of the upper and lower chambers of parliament.
* A parliamentary commision met representatives from the Defence Ministry to discuss Romania's contribution to the peacekeeping to be sent to Albania. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
